location_description:
Hales Corners is a village in Milwaukee County, Wisconsin, United States. The population was 7,692 at the 2010 census.


== History ==
The land in the area that would eventually encompass the Village was first claimed as French, then British, and eventually as the Northwest Territory of the United States in 1783.
